title: BNCI 2014-009 P300 dataset
description: A P300 brain-computer interface EEG dataset from 10 healthy, BCI-experienced female participants who selected one of 36 characters using two visual spelling interfaces: the P300 Speller (overt attention) and GeoSpell (covert attention). EEG was recorded from 16 scalp electrodes across multiple sessions. The dataset supports analysis of P300 latency jitter and its relationship to BCI classification performance.
methods_description: Scalp EEG was recorded from 16 Ag/AgCl electrodes (10-10 placement) with a g.USBamp amplifier at 256 Hz, referenced to linked earlobes and grounded at the right mastoid. The signal was band-pass filtered at 0.1-20 Hz, and impedance was kept below 10 kOhm. Stimulation, acquisition and online classification used BCI2000. Each trial comprised eight stimulation sequences (16 target intensifications) with 125 ms intensification, 125 ms ISI and 250 ms SOA. Subjects performed three runs with each interface per session.
